definitions.explanation: The hand on the right side of the body.

examples.english: To hold chopsticks with the right hand.

examples.japanese: {右手|みぎて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{右手|みぎて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: He was walking with luggage in his right hand.

notes:
{右手|みぎて} combines ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧ (right) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand). Can also mean "the right side" or "right-hand side" when giving directions.

PRONUNCIATION:
Always read みぎて. The alternative reading うて is archaic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右手|みぎて}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold with the right hand
- {右手|みぎて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to raise one's right hand
- {右手|みぎて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: visible on the right side

DIRECTIONAL USE:
{右手|みぎて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ can mean "on your right" when giving directions: {右手|みぎて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (you'll see the park on your right).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{左手|ひだりて}→左手：10975_hidarite⟧: left hand
- ⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧: both hands
- ⟦{利|き}き{手|て}→利き手：19086_kikite⟧: dominant hand
- ⟦{右利|みぎき}き→右利き：17053_migikiki⟧: right-handed
